parameters: Looks like the enemy's grown a spine...\| didn't expect them to send such an army here.\! If we lose Embor, it's all over, Zelos.
An attack like this would have been wise months ago. But now we're prepared.\! You've come a long way Lindly. Let's make them pay dearly.
Right. To Embor, on the double!
Lindly's force has arrived... thank Donar.\! Jules, Narima, rain down fire from those walls!\! Lysander, you and I must stop their advance here.
I'll do my best, Diana! Be careful down there!
Looks like it's our time to shine, kitty cat.\! Some heavy squads are tryin' to flank us.\! Almost as diabolical as AAA microtransactions...
Anyway, Light squads like yours and mine can ambush 'em.\! Just wait for them to be in range, and attack in the woods, they won't know what hit 'em!
Cavalry coming from the North!\! Watch out, if they travel their full movement range, their attack will be a "Charge attack", inflicting a stun on anyone they hit.

Thank you for playing the Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga demo!\! This has been a passion project for over 6 years with so much more to it than this demo, and we are so excited to finally get it out there.\! Please wish list it on Steam, it helps us out a lot! And please join our community discord - we'd love to hear from you!
